result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen. It appears mostly functional, but there is a loading spinner on the 'Popular right now' Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, suggesting incomplete image loading, and some content is truncated at the right edge.

issues.description: A loading spinner overlays the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image in the 'Popular right now' section, indicating the image has not finished loading or is stuck.
issues.suggestion: Ensure images load fully or add a proper placeholder/timeout fallback so content displays correctly.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal list is cut off on the right edge, with 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name truncated.
issues.suggestion: This is expected for a horizontal scroll carousel, but ensure card partial visibility clearly signals scrollability; consider a peek indicator or consistent edge padding.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in 'Popular right now' is partially cut off with no visible restaurant name or details in view.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the card fully renders when scrolled into view; this is likely just due to viewport cropping.
